newsitem.title: USA: Banc One completes First USA acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Banc One completes First USA acquisition.

text.p: Banc One Corp said Friday it has completed the $7.9 billion acquisition of First USA Inc.

In the transaction, shareholders of First USA will receive 1.1659 shares of Banc One for each First USA share held. Based on Banc One's closing price on June 26, the value of the deal is $56.84 for each First USA share, Banc One said.

The combination of First USA's operations with Banc One's 16.0 million cardholders and $11.9 billion in managed card receivables will produce the nation's third-largest card operation with 32.3 million cardholders and card assets of $35.1 billion, Banc One said.

First USA is a financial services company specializing in the credit card business. It is the fourth largest among domestic Visa and MasterCard issuers with $23.2 billion in managed receivables and 16.3 million cardholders.

Banc One, a bank holding company with a credit card and merchant processing business, among a number of units, has assets of $101.6 billion. The company has $11.9 billion in managed card receivables and 16.0 million cardholders.
